geoglows_clock: UTC hour start; shift +1h to hour end, then aggregate exactly 24 valid hourly means to each UTC day, matching local preparation
concurrency: One GEOGLOWS worker and two Earth Engine workers; no GPU
membership: All mapped donor/external records, including spatial review flags and records without observational overlap; acquisition does not approve model matching or verification quality
aggregation: Use reference gauge catchments for all weather, landscape and AlphaEarth means; use mapped global-model reach for Q; retain reference/model area mismatch
scope: Acquire matched inputs and audit support only; no regional model fitting
geoglows_batch: Group requested reaches by underlying 20-river storage chunk; one worker to bound decompression memory
